payer_name.rationale: PayerName/BusinessNameLine1Txt maps to the primary payer name line in the payer block.

payer_address.rationale: Blueprint bundles street address into one string; canonical splits PayerUSAddress into AddressLine1Txt, CityNm, StateAbbreviationCd, ZIPCd — blueprint should split into separate fields.

payer_city_state_zip.rationale: Blueprint bundles city/state/zip into one string; canonical PayerUSAddress splits these into CityNm, StateAbbreviationCd, ZIPCd — blueprint should split into separate fields.

payer_telephone.rationale: PhoneNum at root level corresponds to the payer's telephone number printed in the payer block.

payer_tin.rationale: PayerEIN directly maps to the PAYER'S TIN box on the form.

recipient_tin.rationale: RecipientSSN maps to the RECIPIENT'S TIN box; canonical schema uses RecipientSSN (or RecipientEIN at idx 28), but RecipientSSN is the primary field for this box.

recipient_name.rationale: RecipientNm directly corresponds to the recipient name box on the form.

recipient_address.rationale: Blueprint bundles street address into one string; canonical RecipientUSAddress/RecipientForeignAddress splits into AddressLine1Txt, AddressLine2Txt, CityNm, etc. — blueprint should split into separate fields.

recipient_city_state_zip.rationale: Blueprint bundles city/state/zip into one string; canonical RecipientUSAddress splits these into CityNm, StateAbbreviationCd, ZIPCd — blueprint should split into separate fields.

account_number.rationale: RecipientAccountNum directly maps to the account number box at the lower left of the form.

corrected.rationale: CorrectedInd maps directly to the CORRECTED checkbox at the top of the form.

fatca_filing_requirement.rationale: FATCAFilingRequirementInd directly maps to the FATCA filing requirement checkbox on the form.

oid_on_us_treasury_obligations.rationale: TreasuryObligationOIDAmt maps to Box 1 — Original issue discount on U.S. Treasury obligations.

other_periodic_interest.rationale: OtherPeriodicInterestAmt directly maps to Box 2 — Other periodic interest.

early_withdrawal_penalty.rationale: EarlyWithdrawalPenaltyAmt directly maps to Box 3 — Early withdrawal penalty.

federal_income_tax_withheld.rationale: FederalIncomeTaxWithheldAmt directly maps to Box 4 — Federal income tax withheld.

market_discount.rationale: MarketDiscountAmt directly maps to Box 5 — Market discount.

acquisition_premium.rationale: AcquisitionPremiumAmt directly maps to Box 6 — Acquisition premium.

description_of_obligation.rationale: CUSIPNumberOrObligationDesc maps to Box 7 — Description of the debt instrument.

oid_on_us_savings_bonds.rationale: OriginalIssueDiscountAmt maps to Box 8 — Original issue discount on U.S. savings bonds and similar instruments.

investment_expenses.rationale: InvestmentExpenseAmt directly maps to Box 9 — Investment expenses.

bond_premium.rationale: BondPremiumAmt directly maps to Box 10 — Bond premium.

tax_exempt_oid.rationale: TaxExemptOIDAmt directly maps to Box 11 — OID on a tax-exempt obligation.

state_1.rationale: StateAbbreviationCd within Form1099OIDStateLocalTaxGrp maps to Box 12 first state abbreviation.

payer_state_number_1.rationale: StateIdNum within Form1099OIDStateLocalTaxGrp maps to Box 12 payer's state identification number for the first state.

state_income_tax_withheld_1.rationale: StateTaxWithheldAmt within Form1099OIDStateLocalTaxGrp maps to Box 13 state income tax withheld for the first state.

state_2.rationale: StateAbbreviationCd in the second Form1099OIDStateLocalTaxGrp instance maps to Box 12 second state; the group repeats for the second state entry.

payer_state_number_2.rationale: StateIdNum in the second Form1099OIDStateLocalTaxGrp instance maps to Box 12 payer's state ID for the second state.

state_income_tax_withheld_2.rationale: StateTaxWithheldAmt in the second Form1099OIDStateLocalTaxGrp instance maps to Box 13 state income tax withheld for the second state.

tax_year.rationale: CalendarYr directly maps to the calendar tax year printed on the form.
